title: •2-1B (Too-Onebee)
caption: •2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V)
game_text: Once per turn, may place your non-droid character just lost at same or related site in Used Pile instead of Lost Pile. X on Bacta Tank is -2.
lore: Made by Genetech. Unusually independent for a droid. Forced to serve a Moff on Firro, but was liberated by Tiree. Now dedicated to serving the Alliance.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Slip has two stat boxes (POWER 0, MEDICAL DROID label). No icons in the column (only the blue virtual-set sphere, cropped at the right edge). The 745 px Hoth-L-21btooonebee.gif is the PC Errata face (D-E1, errata game text) — downloaded to src/vs4/ but the 350 px decipher-archive printed face is used. Lore matches the scan. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2-L-21btooonebee-pre.gif, 350 px; the non-pre VB2 file also downloaded). Copyright 1996 (Hoth), legible on the 745 face.
